subject: Commit Orchestra: QBR Pipeline Scrub Schedule & Leadership Pack Rotation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit Orchestra: QBR Pipeline Scrub Schedule & Leadership Pack Rotation

Team — kicking off the month-end / QBR scrub rhythm I want to land for this quarter. Goal: a lightweight, deterministic flow so leadership receives an exec pack that’s consistent across accounts and stage owners.

Key asks: 
- Please confirm the owner for each top-10 commit (we'll use the stage owners doc in the Drive link).
- Lauren: can you own the leadership pack assembly this round? I added a template and a calendar slot.
- Grace / Karthik: rotate as stage reviewers for Gate 2 and Gate 3 respectively.
- External ask to ACME: Sara — can you provide the latest ARR/ACV slides and any redlines to the forecast by EOD next Wed so we can include them in the leadership pack?

Attached: Q3_leadership_pack_template.pptx (template), commit-orchestra-calendar.ics (calendar slot).

Timeline (tight):
- Wed Aug 4 EOD: commit owners confirm numbers + blockers
- Thu Aug 5: stage reviewer pass (Gate 2 / Gate 3)
- Fri Aug 6 10:00am: leadership pack finalization and stitch call

Notes: keep comments in the shared Drive doc rather than long email threads so we have a single source of truth.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit Orchestra: QBR Pipeline Scrub Schedule & Leadership Pack Rotation

Thanks Aditya — happy to own the leadership pack this round. A few logistics/asks from my side: 
- I'll pull the top-10 commit slides into the template. Please add a one-line status for each commit in the Drive (Owner / Last update / Key blocker).
- For SaaS deals (ACME included), we need the ARR reconciliation table by Wed EOD to avoid last-minute rework.
- Grace/Karthik: I'll ping you both separately with the Gate reviewer checklist. If either of you can't do the pass on Thu, flag now and we'll find backup.

Subject: Re: Commit Orchestra: QBR Pipeline Scrub Schedule & Leadership Pack Rotation

Hi Aditya / Lauren — thanks for the heads up. ACME will provide the updated ARR slide and a short note on renewal timing by Tue Aug 3 EOD (we have an internal finance sync Mon morning).

Quick Q: should we include a detailed discount history slide or just the current committed price and rationale? Our CS lead prefers a brief summary to keep the pack lean.

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit Orchestra: QBR Pipeline Scrub Schedule & Leadership Pack Rotation

Got it — thanks Sara. Keep the pack lean: include current committed price + one-line rationale, and a very short appendix (1 slide) if there's a complex discount history we need to preserve for audit.

Action items recap (updated):
- All commit owners: populate Owner / Last update / Blocker in the shared Drive by Wed Aug 4 EOD.
- ACME (Sara): ARR + renewal timing by Tue Aug 3 EOD.
- Lauren: assemble slides into the template and share draft by Thu Aug 5 09:00am.
- Grace/Karthik: reviewer passes on Thu Aug 5.

Attached the calendar slot and the template again for visibility. I'll run the stitch call Fri Aug 6 10:00am (invite on the calendar).

Thanks everyone — let's keep comments in Drive.

Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q3_leadership_pack_template.pptx (pptx, 2.6MB), commit-orchestra-calendar.ics (calendar event)
